Recorded claim:
`commands/graph/treeherder.mjs` searches the latest 50 pushes each from `comm-central`, `try-comm-central`, and `try`. Matching evidence is not restricted to identical job names/platform settings; `try-monitor.mjs` routes patch failures to repair, unknown failures to investigation, and all-existing/unrelated failures to Pass.
